title: 第4章  你脱光了我也不会看一眼
content_zh:
杂役弟子住处，苏烬生盘腿坐在床榻上，将那个霸道未婚妻留下的储物戒拿了出来。
神识一动，储物戒内的空间便一目了然。
储物戒空间不大，约莫一丈长宽，摆放着一个大小刚好的架子。
架子上放着两个小瓷瓶，分别是一品凝气丹五枚，二品疗伤丹五枚！
一侧，还摆放着一本凡阶中品武技，一剑斩！
地面上，除了一柄中品凡器之外，还堆积着三百枚下品灵石。
这些东西对于他来说，除了那本凡阶中品武技之外，都对他修炼有很大帮助。
足以让他突破两重境界，甚至，突破三重境界也不是不可能！
至于那本凡阶中品武技，则没有多大用处，因为他先前修炼过更加高级的武技。
武技一共划分为五个境界，分别是凡阶，黄阶，玄阶，地阶，天阶！
每个境界又分低级，中级，高级！
他曾经作为内门弟子之时，修炼的便是黄阶高级武技！
只不过，如今境界太低，灵气太少，根本无法催动！
苏烬生翻手间，将那一柄中品凡器取了出来，熟练的挥动了几下。
时隔一年时间，也不知道剑术生涩了没有。
先前，他的兵器乃是一柄上品凡器，只不过，境界跌落之后，便被人抢去了。
自此之后，便再也没有摸过佩剑。
虽然这一柄乃是中品凡器，但也够用了。
意识挥动间，中品凡器收入储物戒中，取出一枚凝气丹，吞入口中。
丹药入口即化，如暖流一般流入丹田之中。

随即，周围灵气汇聚身前，供丹田吞噬。
这便是凝气丹的功效，可以让身前灵气变得浓郁，提升修炼速度。
除却丹田之外，还有神秘种子吞噬灵气的速度也是直接翻倍。
这就等同于，此刻他的修炼速度是常人的四倍不止！
苏烬生双眸微闭，双手合圆放置身前，控制着丹田肆意吞噬灵气。
如今他身上有霸道未婚妻留下的五枚凝气丹，抢了于彦君一枚，还有林月舒赠予的一枚，加上他自身的一枚，刚好八枚。
还有三百三十枚下品灵石，足以让他突破境界了！
时间流逝，转眼便是翌日清晨。
“砰！”
微弱的气息从苏烬生身上散发而出，不到一天的时间，他便再次突破境界，达到炼气三重之境！
这些境界都是他当初踏入过的，所以，突破起来基本都是水到渠成，没什么阻碍。
苏烬生睁开双眸，眼中涌现出丝丝笑意。
若是按照这个速度下去，最多一年时间，便能够重回巅峰！
只可惜，他没有充足的凝气丹与灵石。
仅是这一天时间，他就足足消耗了四枚凝气丹！
如今，他还剩下四枚凝气丹以及三百三十枚下品灵石！
再突破一重境界，不成问题。
想到这里，便要继续修炼。
“砰……砰砰……”
就在这时，一阵敲门声响起，传入耳中。

苏烬生停下手中动作，眉头轻皱，起身便朝着院子外走去，心中暗道。
这个时候，林月舒应该担心耽误他修炼，不会来找他。
那会是谁呢？
要知道，自从他境界跌落，沦落如此下场之后，便只有林月舒找他的时候会敲门。
若是换做其他人，可能就直接踹开了。
“吱~呀！”
这女子眉毛纤细，双眸冰冷，鼻梁高挺，嘴唇微厚，脖颈细长，肌肤白皙如玉。
紧身红衣将前凸后翘的身躯展现的淋漓尽致。
这等貌美女子，无论走到何处，都让人难以移开双目！
然而，苏烬生的面色却是瞬间阴沉了下来，心中涌出阵阵怒意。
因为眼前这女子便是姜紫嫣，在他跌落神坛后与他划清界限的贱女人。
“你来做什么！”
苏烬生声音冷漠，不带有丝毫感情。
姜紫嫣听到这语气后微微一愣，先前，苏烬生与他言语都是柔声和气的，何时这般冷漠过？
不过，想到他这一年来的遭遇后，也就明白了。
“还在生我的气？”
苏烬生脸上露出一抹冷笑，回答出声。
“你是谁？有什么值得我生气的地方吗？”
闻言，姜紫嫣闻言，脸上也是露出一副愧疚之意，不过却是转瞬即逝。
“我知道你心里还恨我，但我也没有办法！”

“毕竟，我可是有希望参加十三峰比试的弟子，而你只是一个境界跌跌不休，看不到希望的弟子！”
“若出手帮助你，必定会影响我的前途，所以你不能怪我，因为我没有错！”
参加十三峰比试，乃是紫幕神山所有弟子所向往的，因为一旦胜利，便可加入紫幕神山主峰！
他们如今所待的紫幕神山，不过只是一座偏峰罢了。
苏烬生闻言，脸上笑意更冷，心中怒气更浓，言语都变得有些低沉。
“当初要不是老子帮你，别说十三峰比试，你连成为内门弟子都难！”
当初，他可是将自身大部分的修炼资源都交给了这个姜紫嫣。
即便如此，他依旧凭借天赋，做到了内门弟子第一人！
“过去的事情都已经过去了，没有必要再提！”
姜紫嫣神情冷漠，轻描淡写出声。
“听说你能修炼了，我特意拿了十枚凝气丹和一千枚下品灵石帮你！”
“只要你一年之内能够重新回到聚灵境，那我们不是没有可能！”
十枚凝气丹？
一千枚下品灵石？
这点东西都比不上当初他给姜紫嫣的十分之一！
苏烬生面色愈发冰冷，看都没看那些修炼资源一眼，而是盯着姜紫嫣，低沉道。
“你放心，一年后我不但能重回聚灵境，还会代替宗门参加十三峰比试！”
“至于你，就算脱光了在我面前，我也不会看一眼！”
“你知道我如今是何等境界吗？就敢口出狂言！”
“我告诉你，我如今乃是聚灵九重，一年后必然能够达到归元一重境！”

“而如今的你，连我气息威压都抵挡不住，拿什么和我争？”
姜紫嫣的面色变得有些难看，心中生出几分怒意，如今她也算是内门弟子中最为亮眼的。
追求者无数，却被一个废物说脱光了都不看，这对她来说，无疑是莫大的侮辱！
“还想让本姑娘脱光了给你看，真是痴心妄想！”
“能不能争，一年后我们拭目以待！”
苏烬生言语平淡，目光上下扫视了一番，继而出声道。
“我都说了，就算你脱光衣服，老子也不会看一眼的！”
“你……”
姜紫嫣面色一沉，怒意涌现，声音也是戛然而止，不知如何反驳。
紧接着，眼中闪过寒光，露出一个高傲的模样。
“原本我今日来是给你送修炼资源的！”
“但既然你想要与我争夺十三峰比试资格，那这修炼资源便不送了！
说到这里，脸上露出一副意味深长的表情，戏谑道。
“我倒要看看，一年后你如何与我争！”
音落，便直接转身迈步，离开了此地。
苏烬生望着那道离去的身影，双眼微微眯起，眼中乍现寒光，心中暗道出声。
姜紫嫣，老子会让你知道，自己错的有多离谱了！
虽然只有一年时间，但凭借神秘种子的逆天功效，他坚信能在十三峰比试前达到前所未有的巅峰。
要知道，神秘种子所转化的精纯灵气无时不刻在滋润体质，增强力量！
仅是昨天一天时间，他就感觉自身的体质力量增强了不少。

并且，此刻依旧在持续增强！
最主要的是，他认为，神秘种子的功效绝对不止如此。
因为神秘种子如今还只是刚刚发芽而已，等开花结果之后，不知还会暴露什么逆天功效！
content_en:
In the residence of the handyman disciple, Su Jinsheng sat cross-legged on the bed and took out the storage ring left by the overbearing fiancée.
As soon as his consciousness moved, the space inside the storage ring became clear at a glance.
The storage ring is not very spacious, about one foot long and wide, with a shelf of just the right size.
There are two small porcelain bottles on the shelf, containing five first-grade Qi Condensing Pills and five second-grade Healing Pills!
On one side, there is also a book of mortal-level middle-grade martial arts, slash with one sword!
On the ground, in addition to a medium-grade mortal weapon, there were also three hundred low-grade spiritual stones piled up.
For him, these things, except for the middle-grade mortal martial arts, were of great help to his cultivation.
It's enough for him to break through the second realm, and even breaking through the third realm is not impossible!
As for the mid-level mortal martial arts, they were of little use because he had previously practiced more advanced martial arts.
Martial arts are divided into five realms, namely mortal level, yellow level, mysterious level, earth level, and heaven level!
Each realm is divided into low level, intermediate level and high level!
When he was an inner disciple, he practiced yellow-level advanced martial arts!
However, now the realm is too low and the spiritual energy is too little, so it cannot be activated at all!
Su Jinsheng turned his hand, took out the middle-grade mortal weapon, and waved it skillfully a few times.
After a year, I don’t know if my swordsmanship has become dull.
Previously, his weapon was a high-grade mortal weapon, but after his realm fell, he was snatched away.
Since then, he has never touched the sword again.
Although this handle is a middle-grade mortal weapon, it is enough.
In a flash of consciousness, he put the medium-grade mortal weapon into the storage ring, took out a Qi Condensing Pill, and swallowed it in his mouth.
The elixir melts instantly in the mouth and flows into the Dantian like a warm current.
Immediately, the surrounding spiritual energy gathered in front of him, for the Dantian to devour.
This is the effect of the Qi Condensing Pill, which can make the spiritual energy in front of you richer and increase the speed of cultivation.
In addition to the Dantian, there are also mysterious seeds that can devour spiritual energy at twice the speed.
This is equivalent to that his cultivation speed at this moment is more than four times that of ordinary people!
Su Jinsheng closed his eyes slightly, placed his hands in a circle in front of his body, and controlled his Dantian to swallow spiritual energy wantonly.
Now he has five Qi Condensing Pills left by his overbearing fiancée, snatched one from Yu Yanjun, and one gifted by Lin Yueshu. Plus one of his own, there are exactly eight pills.
There are still 330 low-grade spiritual stones, which is enough for him to break through the realm!
Time passed and it was the next morning in a blink of an eye.
"Bang!"
A weak aura emanated from Su Jinsheng. In less than a day, he broke through again and reached the third level of Qi refining!
He had already entered these realms before, so his breakthrough was basically a matter of course, without any obstacles.
Su Jinsheng opened his eyes, and there was a hint of smile in his eyes.
If we continue at this rate, we will be able to return to the top in a year at most!
It's a pity that he doesn't have enough Qi Condensing Pills and Spiritual Stones.
In this day alone, he consumed four Qi Condensing Pills!
Now, he still has four Qi Condensing Pills and 330 low-grade spiritual stones left!
Breaking through to the next level is not a problem.
Thinking of this, I have to continue practicing.
"Bang...bang bang..."
At this moment, a knock on the door sounded and reached his ears.
Su Jinsheng stopped what he was doing, frowned slightly, stood up and walked out of the yard, thinking to himself.
At this time, Lin Yueshu should be worried about delaying his cultivation and would not come to him.
Who could it be?
You know, ever since his realm fell and he ended up like this, Lin Yueshu was the only one who would knock on the door when she came looking for him.
If it were anyone else, they might just kick him away.
"Squeak!"
This woman has slender eyebrows, cold eyes, a high nose bridge, slightly thick lips, a slender neck, and skin as fair as jade.
The tight-fitting red dress vividly shows off the bulging body.
Such a beautiful woman, no matter where she goesWherever you go, it’s hard to take your eyes off!
However, Su Jinsheng's face instantly darkened, and bursts of anger surged in his heart.
Because the woman in front of him is Jiang Ziyan, the bitch who drew a clear line with him after he fell from the altar.
"What are you doing here!"
Su Jinsheng's voice was cold and emotionless.
Jiang Ziyan was slightly startled when she heard this tone. Previously, Su Jinsheng had spoken softly and kindly to him. When had she ever been so indifferent?
However, after thinking about what he has experienced this year, it becomes clear.
"Still angry with me?"
A sneer appeared on Su Jinsheng's face and he answered.
"Who are you? Is there anything I should be angry about?"
Hearing this, Jiang Ziyan also showed a look of guilt on her face, but it was fleeting.
"I know you still hate me in your heart, but there's nothing I can do about it!"
"After all, I am a disciple who hopes to participate in the Thirteen Peaks competition, and you are just a disciple who is constantly falling and has no hope!"
"If I help you, it will definitely affect my future, so you can't blame me, because I am not wrong!"
Participating in the Thirteen Peaks Competition is what all the disciples of the Purple Curtain Mountain long for, because once they win, they can join the main peak of the Purple Curtain Mountain!
The Purple Curtain Mountain they are currently staying at is just a partial peak.
When Su Jinsheng heard this, the smile on his face became colder, the anger in his heart became stronger, and his words became a little lower.
"If I hadn't helped you back then, let alone the Thirteen Peaks Competition, it would have been difficult for you to become an inner disciple!"
At the beginning, he gave most of his cultivation resources to Jiang Ziyan.
Even so, he still relied on his talent to become the number one inner disciple!
"What happened in the past is in the past, there is no need to mention it again!"
Jiang Ziyan looked indifferent and spoke lightly.
"I heard that you can practice, so I specially brought ten Qi Condensing Pills and a thousand low-grade spiritual stones to help you!"
"As long as you can return to the Spirit Gathering Realm within a year, it's not impossible for us!"
Ten Qi Condensing Pills?
A thousand low-grade spiritual stones?
This little thing is not as good as one-tenth of what he gave Jiang Ziyan!
Su Jinsheng's face became colder and colder. He didn't even look at the cultivation resources. Instead, he stared at Jiang Ziyan and said in a low voice.
"Don't worry, not only will I be able to return to the Soul Gathering Realm in a year, but I will also participate in the Thirteen Peaks Competition on behalf of the sect!"
"As for you, even if you were naked in front of me, I wouldn't even look at you!"
"Do you know what state I am in now? I dare to speak arrogantly!"
"Let me tell you, I am currently at the ninth level of Soul Gathering, and I will definitely be able to reach the first level of Guiyuan in one year!"
"And now you can't even withstand the pressure of my aura, so why should you fight with me?"
Jiang Ziyan's complexion became a little ugly, and she felt a little angry in her heart. Now she is considered the most outstanding among the inner disciples.
She has countless suitors, but to be told by a loser that she even took off her clothes without even looking at her, this is undoubtedly a huge insult to her!
"You want me to strip naked and show you, what a wishful thinking!"
"Whether we can fight for it or not, we'll see in a year's time!"
Su Jinsheng spoke calmly, glanced up and down, and then spoke.
"I told you, even if you take off your clothes, I won't even look at you!"
"You..."
Jiang Ziyan's face darkened, anger emerged, and her voice stopped abruptly, not knowing how to refute.
Then, a cold light flashed in his eyes, revealing a proud look.
"Originally, I came today to give you training resources!"
"But since you want to compete with me for qualifications for the Thirteen Peaks competition, then you won't give me these training resources!
At this point, a meaningful expression appeared on his face and he joked.
"I want to see how you can compete with me in a year! "
As soon as the sound fell, he turned around and walked away from this place.
Su Jinsheng looked at the leaving figure and narrowed his eyes slightly.Standing up, a cold light suddenly appeared in his eyes, and he secretly said something in his heart.
Jiang Ziyan, I will let you know how wrong you are!
Although he only had one year, with the heaven-defying effects of the mysterious seeds, he firmly believed that he could reach an unprecedented peak before the competition on the Thirteen Peaks.
You must know that the pure spiritual energy transformed by the mysterious seeds is nourishing the body and enhancing strength all the time!
Just yesterday, he felt that his physical strength had increased a lot.
Moreover, it is still continuing to strengthen at this moment!
The most important thing is that he believes that the efficacy of the mysterious seeds is definitely more than that.
Because the mysterious seeds have only just sprouted now. After they bloom and bear fruit, I don’t know what other heaven-defying effects they will reveal!
